newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rautaruukki sells coking plant technology.
newsitem.headline: Rautaruukki sells coking plant technology.

text.p: Finnish steel group Rautaruukki Oy said on Wednesday it had signed two contracts together worth more than 50 million markka to deliver coking plant technology to Poland.
"Rautaruukki Engineering has signed two contracts for coking plant technology with Polish coking plants," Rautaruukki said in a statement.
Rautaruukki will supply automated process control systems to the coking plant of Polish Huta IM. Tadeusza Sendzimira.
It said the order included planning, supply of equipment, training and comissioning services.
The other contract is the modernisation of a dry quenching plant at the Przyjazn coking plant. This project will involve the rebuilding of six old dry quenching units, Rautaruukki said.
